summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a Form 6-K announcing an amended investor rights agreement with Mitsubishi Materials, extending rights until November 2028. Mitsubishi Materials will buy 1.2 million shares in open market purchases at market prices (non-dilutive, no new shares), returning its ownership to ~5%. The board approved the amendment; no advisor named. This is a strategic partnership extension, not a material M&A or corporate action. No premium, price, or close date is specified. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report. Watch for open market purchase completion and ongoing Casino Project development.
